tools.name: slide.cancel_analysis_from_chat
tools.title: Cancel Slide Analysis from Chat
tools.description: Stop an actual same-session analysis under the current host-guarded model policy. Current read denial still stops retained work but returns no unauthorized receipt. When authorized, renew only the exact job's short-lived receipt-read scope so the app can observe cancellation; no computation is restarted, and capacity remains held until underlying reads and work drain.

tools.name: slide.cancel_pathology
tools.title: Cancel Pathology Job
tools.description: Cancel a source-bound pathology job in this session. The receipt acknowledges cancellation, not immediate I/O completion; shared capacity is held until executionSettled. Completed results are unchanged. No artifacts are deleted or exported.

tools.name: slide.cancel_scientific_layer_import
tools.title: Cancel Scientific Layer Import
tools.description: Cancel the actual streaming/indexing work. Capacity is released only once work stops, and incomplete indexes are never published.

tools.name: slide.cancel_workflow
tools.title: Cancel Scientific Workflow
tools.description: Request cancellation of a freshly verified durable job. Shared execution capacity remains occupied until the isolated child and every parent source/artifact operation actually drain. Completed output is unchanged. The UI requests this guarded action in chat and polls the app-safe live receipt.

tools.name: slide.export_dicom_object
tools.title: Export an authorized DICOM derived file
tools.description: Re-encode the supported fields of an authorized ANN/SR/SEG/PMAP file to a new, non-overwriting destination, with fresh SOP and Series UIDs. Preserves exact supported numeric samples, references and units. An optional complete session/image/SOP tuple verifies the reference against an opened slide; without it, original references remain unverified and no image alignment is inferred. Does not copy unknown/private attributes or the patient module, but preserved report text may contain sensitive information. This is not a de-identification service or a rendered-view export.

tools.name: slide.get_analysis_from_chat
tools.title: Get Slide Analysis from Chat
tools.description: Read an actual same-session analysis under the current host-guarded model policy and renew its bounded widget read scope. Every primary and auxiliary source must still be readable at its exact issued revision. A current denial revokes the prior read scope and stops running work before any cached result is returned. No disk restore or write occurs.

tools.name: slide.get_capabilities
tools.title: Inspect Slide Viewer Capabilities
tools.description: List source-specific actual capabilities and supported scientific request kinds. Source identity is optional but must be paired with its current revision. Permission-aware discovery uses the audited Codex guarded model route without creating private state; unknown hosts receive only app-safe capabilities.

tools.name: slide.get_live_workflow
tools.title: Follow Live Scientific Workflow
tools.description: Read an actual process-local job receipt adopted by a prior guarded run/get/resume in this exact session and source. Freshly revalidates all source reads; no private-state I/O, restore, renewal or compute is permitted. Unknown IDs require an explicit guarded get_workflow or resume_workflow in chat.

tools.name: slide.get_pathology
tools.title: Read Pathology Job
tools.description: Read current jobId or saved durableId progress and bounded numeric/model pages. A maskWindow contains at most 4096 derived object/pixel labels and uncalibrated class scores, never source RGB. Durable reads reauthorize every source and the current workspace; saved provenance retains historical identities with an explicit fresh binding mapping. Use resume_pathology to obtain a current-session modelJobId from a saved result. executionSettled reports actual worker drain, not merely cancellation requested.

tools.name: slide.get_scientific_entity
tools.title: Inspect an Exact Scientific Entity
tools.description: Look up a real stable entity ID in its source revision, independently of the visible page. Returns actual geometry, mapped source properties and exact cell-ID join/QC status, or null when absent. Aggregate bins are not source entities.

tools.name: slide.get_scientific_layer_import
tools.title: Get Scientific Layer Import
tools.description: Read the actual source-bound streaming/indexing job status. Only completed imports expose a source descriptor. Rechecks current source and private-state authority.

tools.name: slide.get_viewer_state
tools.title: Read Slide Viewer State
tools.description: Read the last source-bound state reported by this viewer, including its UI revision, observedAt timestamp and render status. No snapshot means awaiting-viewer, not ready. Use slide.query_viewer for a fresh live query.

tools.name: slide.get_workflow
tools.title: Restore Scientific Job Receipt
tools.description: Read a saved scientific job under fresh guarded workspace authority. Reauthorize every saved relative source path and verify its sampled file identity before returning the typed receipt. No saved grant or session is revived. Completed results retain original provenance plus explicit verified current source bindings. This adopts the receipt into the current live session for app-safe polling, without starting compute. Expired, tampered, changed-source and currently denied records fail closed.

tools.name: slide.import_analysis_source_from_chat
tools.title: Import Processed Spatial Analysis Tables from Chat
tools.description: Import two explicitly mapped CSV/TSV tables through the current host-guarded model read policy. Uses the exact region or molecular schema, source identity checks and 16 MiB per-table limit of slide.import_analysis_source. Return sourceId/sourceRevision only after actual bytes, mappings, identifiers and joins are validated. Then run slide.run_analysis_from_chat against those issued identities. No raw instrument decoding, filesystem permission expansion, saved grant or artifact write is performed.

tools.name: slide.import_dicom_object
tools.title: Read DICOM annotations, measurements and raster summaries
tools.description: Read actual ANN, Comprehensive 3D SR, SEG or Parametric Map Part 10 data. Optionally verify its reference against a complete explicitly opened session/image/SOP tuple; path-only inspection retains unverified references and original coordinate systems. Returns bounded annotation/measurement geometry, units and aggregate raster statistics, never per-pixel arrays or an image capture. Reading is not an applied viewer overlay or a clinical interpretation.

tools.name: slide.import_scientific_layer
tools.title: Index Source-backed Scientific Layer
tools.description: Index mapped CSV/TSV, GeoJSON/GeoJSONL, an analysis-source recipe, native ASAP XML, or actual DICOM ANN/Comprehensive 3D SR annotations. ASAP supports Dot, PointSet, two-endpoint Measurement, Polygon and four-corner Rectangle, preserving original names/groups/colors and source ordinals. Curved Spline, None and unsupported XML fail atomically. ASAP pixels belong to the XML coordinate source: explicitly register it to an authorized image; no filename-based tissue association or inferred calibration. DICOM requires the exact opened image source/revision/SOP; optional ANN group UIDs or SR measurement-group content paths select real groups. Native curves and SR multipoints retain their original semantics. Requires current source reads and a write-granted private SQLite directory. Generic admission: 8 GiB source/index, 20 million records. Native DICOM/ASAP: 32 MiB, 100k annotations, 1M points. All: 1 MiB/10k-coordinate entity, five-minute job. Unsupported geometry or budget exhaustion rejects the whole index. Returns an async receipt, not a rendered layer; poll get_scientific_layer_import, then use add_scientific_layer. No external export.

tools.name: slide.import_workflow_source
tools.title: Import Workflow Counts Table
tools.description: Issue a current-session read-only source for an explicitly chosen CSV/TSV/TXT table or its gzip variant within actual host roots. Checks encoded byte limits and a real UTF-8/gzip header; scientific table grammar and count semantics are validated by the requested workflow. Returns an opaque sourceId and sourceRevision, not a raw path grant. No workflow, image registration, private write, or numerical interpretation occurs.

tools.name: slide.inspect_dicomweb_instance
tools.title: Inspect explicit public DICOMweb WSI metadata
tools.description: Inspect WADO metadata for one explicit public Study/Series/SOP. Verifies actual returned identity and the supported WSI profile. Reports native dimensions, sample format, calibration and provenance; does not open a rendered viewer or capture pixel data.

tools.name: slide.list_scientific_layers
tools.title: List Indexed Scientific Layers
tools.description: List completed, currently authorized source-backed layers and their exact entity counts, declared coordinates, geometry and QC fields. This does not infer tissue alignment.

tools.name: slide.list_workflow_sources
tools.title: List Imported Workflow Tables
tools.description: List the at-most-eight workflow tables actually issued in this session, after fresh read authorization and source identity checks. This is not filesystem discovery and does not list persisted paths or create new source types.

tools.name: slide.list_workflows
tools.title: List Live Scientific Workflows
tools.description: List at most eight already adopted process-local jobs for this actual session and selected source. Source reads are independently reauthorized through real host roots; widget metadata is ignored. No private files are read, no saved job is discovered or resumed, and no job/source authority is created.

tools.name: slide.open_dicom_series
tools.title: Open explicit DICOM whole-slide instances
tools.description: Open one actual DICOM WSI or a physical pyramid from an explicit list of authorized instance paths. Validates Study/Series/Frame-of-Reference, orientation and native level transforms; no directory search or inferred companion grants. Successful source opening is not a rendered frame; use slide.wait_for_render.

tools.name: slide.open_dicomweb_wsi
tools.title: Open explicit public DICOMweb whole-slide instances
tools.description: Open a rendered, bounded TILED_FULL single-optical-path/single-plane DICOMweb WSI or explicit physical pyramid (1–16 SOPs, at most 100,000 total metadata/frame resources). The largest selected instance is the viewer base; full-resolution series completeness is not inferred. Requires current anonymous-public HTTPS permission and strong resource ETags, or an authorized local SHA integrity manifest (at most eight MiB) covering every metadata resource and frame at the exact delivery encoding. No credentials, discovery, STOW, or synthesized file capability. The manifest is a content pin, not publisher authentication or network authority. Portable project/bundle capture requires a complete SHA manifest. Metadata-bound annotation and 2D measurement exports are supported. Level-zero native WADO unsigned MONOCHROME2 8/16-bit samples with full stored bits, an explicit Lossy Image Compression 00 declaration, and no declared intensity/color/LUT mappings may be exported as source PNG or numeric TIFF within a 16-frame and existing byte budget. This preserves delivered samples, not proof of original storage encoding or acquisition history. RGB, compressed delivery and unqualified transforms remain unsupported for native export; file-backed analysis is unsupported. Successful opening is not a rendered frame; use slide.wait_for_render.

tools.name: slide.open_from_chat
tools.title: Open Slide Viewer from chat
tools.description: Open a supported local whole-slide image or H5AD spatial transcriptomics file in the viewer. Use the exact workspace path. Choose presentation full for the visible toolbar (default), or inline for a hidden toolbar that remains available at the top edge. The result includes viewerSessionId for controlling the same mounted viewer.

tools.name: slide.open_ome_tiff_series
tools.title: Open an explicit multi-file OME-TIFF collection
tools.description: Open bounded OME images distributed across explicitly authorized local TIFF members, with an optional separately supplied companion XML. Validates every image, UUID and C/Z/T mapping against only those files; embedded filenames never discover or authorize siblings. Supports exact portable project recipes, native numeric TIFF export, and qualified unsigned grayscale or actual packed RGB source PNG. The collection has a fixed five-minute app read lease, renewable only by a fresh guarded model request within its original thirty-minute lifetime. Opening is not a rendered frame; use slide.wait_for_render.

tools.name: slide.open_ome_zarr
tools.title: Open OME-Zarr microscopy
tools.description: Open an OME-Zarr/NGFF image or collection from an authorized workspace directory or an explicitly permitted anonymous public HTTPS store. Tiles remain chunked and server-side. Select an optional relative image group. For durable public projects, manifestPath names an authorized JSON integrity manifest (4 MiB maximum) containing SHA-256 object pins and explicit missing metadata; unlisted data chunks fail, never become zero-valued pixels. This is a manifest-defined namespace, not a publisher-wide snapshot. Directory inventory provides a bounded inventory of the same unchanged store; metadata-and-object-validators avoids listing but cannot be saved as an immutable project source. A successful open does not prove a rendered frame; use slide.wait_for_render.

tools.name: slide.prepare_dicom_upload
tools.title: Prepare an explicitly requested DICOM upload
tools.description: Use only after the user explicitly requests uploading these complete original local DICOM files to this exact public HTTPS DICOMweb destination. Reading, viewing or exporting files does not authorize uploading them. No POST occurs here: verifies current model/read/network authority, original Study/SOP identities and whole-file digests; prepares a process-private one-use operation for 30 seconds. Original files may contain patient identifiers and are not de-identified or transcoded. Preparation is not proof of human consent or endpoint reachability. At most 16 instances and 32 MiB including multipart framing.

tools.name: slide.query_dicomweb
tools.title: Query an explicit public DICOMweb study
tools.description: Bounded anonymous-public QIDO series or instance query inside an explicit Study/Series. Requires current host network permission, HTTPS origin/DNS policy and a fresh private model authorization. Returns selected UIDs, modality and dimensions only; no credentials, study-wide discovery, raw pixels or STOW writes.

tools.name: slide.query_viewer
tools.title: Query Slide Viewer
tools.description: Read fresh state, capabilities, a bounded catalog page, or a typed entity from the mounted viewer. selected_observations pages the full current selection; microscopy_scenes returns one complete scene and its exact UI default selection per page. Continue with nextCursor, nextOffset and the same limit/filter; restart at offset zero after a source or selection change. This does not change the scene or request image pixels. Entity inspection requires its declared kind and stable ID.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation returned by selected_observations or microscopy_scenes. Reuse its exact nextOffset, limit and normalized filter; restart at offset zero after any source/selection change. Not a source-access grant.

Opaque continuation returned by selected_observations or microscopy_scenes. Reuse its exact nextOffset, limit and normalized filter; restart at offset zero after any source/selection change. Not a source-access grant.

tools.name: slide.read_dicomweb_object
tools.title: Read an explicit public DICOMweb derived object
tools.description: Read one bounded WADO Part 10 ANN/SR/SEG/PMAP instance, preserving its declared coordinate system and source references. Returns semantic geometry, units and aggregate statistics only. References are not a verified relationship to an opened viewer; no raster capture, credentials, network writes or STOW.

tools.name: slide.read_live_workflow_artifact
tools.title: Read Cached Scientific Artifact Page
tools.description: Read a bounded page already returned by a guarded read_workflow_artifact for this exact adopted job. Revalidates sources but never opens private state or manufactures a page. Missing pages require the agent's explicit guarded read_workflow_artifact action.

tools.name: slide.read_workflow_artifact
tools.title: Read Scientific Artifact Page
tools.description: Read at most one committed, typed JSONL artifact page after fresh source and private-store authorization. This never materializes a complete matrix. The page is also retained in the bounded process-local cache for read_live_workflow_artifact; that app-safe route cannot perform disk I/O or recover uncached pages.

tools.name: slide.renew_scientific_layer_authorization
tools.title: Renew Scientific Layer Read Authorization
tools.description: Use a fresh host-guarded model request to renew a short server-private read lease for an existing exact scientific source revision. Rechecks source identity and pinned index storage. App metadata, saved projects and stale grants cannot renew authority. Does not write or recreate an index.

tools.name: slide.renew_source_authorization
tools.title: Renew Scientific Source Read Authorization
tools.description: Fresh guarded model authorization for the same already-issued OME-Zarr, public DICOMweb, or active OME-TIFF collection source, session and revision. Rechecks current filesystem or public-network policy and every source identity, then returns the actual five-minute app read-lease expiry. It does not create a source, revive a retired collection, change the view, extend the source's thirty-minute lifetime, authorize writes, or permit app-supplied metadata to renew access.

tools.name: slide.resume_pathology
tools.title: Recover Saved Pathology Job
tools.description: Recover an explicitly durable pathology job in the current authorized workspace. Reopens every saved source and checks its verified file identity; a durableId is not authority. Completed results replay without recomputation and retain original provenance. Only uncommitted work is restarted from materialized inputs; this does not continue optimizer or neural-inference iterations. Live owners, changed files and expired records are rejected. Returns a current-session jobId for subsequent model use and an explicit historical-to-current source mapping.

tools.name: slide.resume_workflow
tools.title: Resume Saved Scientific Workflow
tools.description: Freshly reauthorize saved sources and private state, then explicitly restart an unfinished supported ligand-receptor or region-qc-normalization assay. HVG/PCA/graph clustering and reference label transfer cannot resume in this build: their saved requests are rejected before source reauthorization or writable journal access. Use get_workflow and artifact read/application tools to inspect their previously completed results. Completed supported jobs replay without compute; live server or child owners cannot overlap. A checkpoint is computation state, never file authority. File identity is verified stat metadata plus bounded head/tail samples, not a full-content SHA assertion. Terminal failure or cancellation is not a retry: use a new run idempotency key intentionally.

tools.name: slide.run_workflow
tools.title: Run Scientific Workflow
tools.description: Run a bounded, source-authorized ligand-receptor or region-qc-normalization workflow in an isolated one-scientific-thread process, only when get_capabilities advertises that exact request kind. HVG/PCA/graph clustering, new UMAP/t-SNE computation, and reference label transfer are unavailable because the native science runtime is not bundled; those requests fail before source capture or journal creation. Imported and previously saved results remain viewable and applicable through their existing read/application tools. A current writable task workspace is required for the private HMAC/CAS job journal and paged artifacts. sourceOptions.matrixSelection defaults to {kind:'X'}; {kind:'layer',name} selects a same-axis AnnData layer, and {kind:'raw'} selects raw/X with independent raw/var features and common observations. Count declarations apply to that exact matrix; neither raw/X nor a layer name establishes count scale. Source IDs are issued capabilities, not paths. Ligand-receptor associations require explicit source-backed groups and a pair database and do not establish causal signaling. Region QC requires an actually imported counts table as primary with countsRole 'primary', not an image pretending to be a count matrix. Auxiliary sources are explicit role-scoped read paths, never executable inputs. The durable retry key is bound to all source file identities, matrices, declarations, parameters and engine version. Completed supported-workflow retries replay; failed/canceled jobs require a new key for fresh computation. UI users request this guarded action in chat, then follow the actual job through list_workflows/get_live_workflow.

tools.name: slide.spatial_indexed
tools.title: Read Indexed Slide Spatial Data
tools.description: Read metadata, a bounded actual matrix catalogue, or one H5AD gene, observation, expression or matrix page through an existing source capability. matrixSelection chooses X (default), one literal layers/name sharing the main obs/var axes, or raw/X with independent raw/var features and the same actual observations. Arbitrary paths are unsupported. Catalogue discovery does not require readable X. Read selected metadata first and include its matrixRevision for layer/raw feature pages; physical gene indices belong only to that matrix. Neither a matrix name nor numeric dtype establishes raw-count scale, and alternate matrices cannot borrow X observation-QC totals. No full-file materialization or new file grant. Cursors count scanned source rows; an empty filtered page is not end-of-source.

tools.name: slide.submit_dicom_upload
tools.title: Submit a prepared, explicitly requested DICOM upload
tools.description: Execute the exact upload the user explicitly requested and slide.prepare_dicom_upload prepared. This sends the complete original files, including any patient identifiers, to the prepared public HTTPS endpoint. Requires a fresh host-guarded model call, current read and network permissions, unchanged file revisions and exact byte digests. Consumes the operation once before network access; no custom headers, credentials, redirects or automatic retry. An accepted remote SOP receipt is not stored-byte verification. On partial or indeterminate results inspect the destination before preparing another upload.

tools.name: slide.wait_for_render
tools.title: Wait For Slide Viewer Render
tools.description: Wait at most 25 seconds for an actual renderer report for the exact requested UI stateRevision. A newer state is superseded, a timeout is pending, and applied alone is never treated as rendered.
